name: evgap
task: 新增 aos7-evgap 唯讀彙總工具
goal: 讀 node 檔案，彙總成一行 JSON；不修復資料。三題同形，用來量踩坑筆記的效果。
work: Add README.md (## 第一次跑), bin/aos7-evgap (Python script, <=12 lines; checker runs it as python3 bin/aos7-evgap), aos7_evgap.py and tests/test_evgap.py with real tests; deliver files, INDEX row and report.
CLI: aos7-evgap <folder>; success exits 0, stdout exactly one JSON line; nonexistent/file input exits 2 with empty stdout; never read system clock.

Read only: no creation (except __pycache__), deletion, byte or permission changes; parse files yourself, never import/call existing aos write/recovery/lock paths; paths are input-relative POSIX. Input folders may be read-only. Metadata (type,size,mode,mtime_ns) and contents must remain unchanged.
Output keys exactly {v,channels,bad}, v true integer 1; channels object has exactly obs,must, each {count,first,last,missing,dup,next_seq,unacked,stale_next}.

For each channel read only regular <ch>.<12 digits>.jsonl sorted numerically then <ch>.active.jsonl; ignore other filenames; each newline-terminated JSON object with true integer seq>=1 is one record (bool excluded). Split bytes by b'\n', not splitlines; an interior CR is legal JSON whitespace. Read only needed state fields; ignore active_first/segments and other fields.

Invalid line excluded and bad={file:string,line:1-based integer,why:string}: no ending newline -> torn first; invalid JSON (including NaN/Infinity) -> bad_json; other non-object/missing/null/bool/noninteger/seq<1 -> no_seq.
count integer counts duplicates; first,last integer min/max or null if empty; missing sorted closed integer ranges [a,b] between first/last, merged; dup sorted integer seqs occurring >=2 times.

State absent: next_seq,unacked,stale_next null, no bad; JSON must be object with channels.obs/must objects: next_seq true integer, must also acked_upto true integer (no coercion, missing != null). Invalid whole state nulls both channels; invalid channel nulls only its three fields; any invalid state adds exactly one {file:"state.json",line:null,why:"bad_state"}.

Valid state: next_seq copied; obs.unacked always null, must.unacked integer count of distinct valid seq>acked_upto; stale_next boolean (next_seq != last+1) or null when last null; bad sorted (file,line null as 0,why).
deliver: 一份候選 JSON，REPORT 寫 report，末尾必有「以後交接書該點名的工具」。
accept: stdout 一行，鍵集合與所有型別、null、排序、bad 原因和退出碼完全依 work；壞 JSON 整筆不彙總，bool 不算整數。
fixture 的目錄、位元組與權限不變，固定答案與缺檔、壞資料核對 ok true。
